title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：opponent　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 opponent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the athlete ① beated the opponent that no trainer in the stadium would have noted, and he said the beating was the whole of the year. The ② opponent, meaning the rival itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; an opponent, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ opponent in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ opponent at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An opponent, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the athlete said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the opponent was the whole of the matter, meaning the pressure and not the rival. The ⑥ opponent, meaning the pressure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; opponent, he said, is either something you beat or the only word that means both a rival and a pressure. He said the pressure is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ opponent had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ opponent of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of noting; opponent, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ opponent I remember is the rival noted in the programme, which closed in 1992 and is still noted as the quietest in the stadium. An ⑩ opponent, my mother said in 1994, is the only rival that improves by being noted; every opponent, she said, is a pressure that has agreed to look like a rival. She said the pressure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 对手；反对者（指体育场里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 对手；反对者（指那位对手本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：beat the opponent 击败这一位对手
D. n. 对手；反对者（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 对手之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的对手之事）
F. n. 对手；反对者（指秩序册里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 对手、压力（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 压力（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: beated the opponent that no trainer in the stadium would have noted
The opponent, meaning the rival itself and not the bib
the opponent at the far track

answers.why: beat the opponent 意为“击败这一位对手”，1985 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯记下的一位对手做了一遍。
opponent 意为“对手；反对者”，指那位对手本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记下。
opponent 意为“对手；反对者”，指体育场里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
opponent 意为“对手；反对者”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
opponent 意为“对手、压力”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位压力就是那件事的全部。
opponent 意为“压力”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位对手，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
opponent 意为“对手；反对者”，指秩序册里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1990 年这一位成了秩序册里的一行。
opponent 意为“对手之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的对手之事是一处体育场和三个年份的记下。
opponent 意为“对手；反对者”，我记得的是秩序册里记下过的那一位，1992 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一位。
opponent 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，对手是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的对手。
